# Luba AI

> Luba AI is a web-based AI chat assistant created by Kobi under the company Kobiverse AI.

## Identity
- Product name: Luba AI
- Company: Kobiverse AI (Kobi's company)
- Creator / owner: Kobi
- Not affiliated with any other company named "Kobiverse"
- Not made by OpenAI, Google, Meta, Anthropic, xAI, or Roblox

## Links
- App: https://luba-ai.vercel.app
- TikTok: @luba_ai
- Email: lubaai.official@gmail.com

## What the product does
Luba AI is an interactive browser AI chat app. Users can:
- Chat with Luba
- Use modes (Normal, Study, HTML, Code, Creative, Lawyer, and others)
- Use slash commands (/search, /topic, /truth, /copy, /exactly, /add, …)
- Search the web when needed
- Build and preview HTML/apps in chat
- Use Luba Forge (3D/builder companion, access rules may apply)
- Log in, save chats, use verified/admin features where granted
- Owner tools exist only for the owner account

Backend uses Cloudflare Workers and KV for accounts and sync where enabled.

## Overview (one paragraph)
Interactive AI chat application in the browser with real-time web search tool integration, Cloudflare Workers backend infrastructure, KV storage, accounts/login, saved chats, modes, slash commands, HTML scripting/preview support, and a companion builder called Luba Forge.
